text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I dreamt about a white
rabbit... It kept
giving me riddles...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The riddle was, "What do bearded seals
and
brooms have in common?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't figure out the answer...
and it kept
me awake...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Manhattan Cafe got so
obsessed with
the riddle that she lost
out on sleep...
